kind: guard-logic self-check — SYNTHETIC per-GPU VRAM values, NO GPU in the loop
not_a_witness_for: the sanctioned 8-rank GPU-node LOAD_READY + serve read-back (that remains the open #4952 definition-of-done; this proves only the pre-flight gate's arithmetic and messaging)
summary: tools/glm52_ep_witness.sh now reads each visible GPU's live free/total VRAM ONCE before the CUDA build + rank spawn and refuses with a single actionable message, instead of surfacing N opaque per-rank FitTooBig walls after spawn. The #4952 report ('needs 73.23 GiB, device has 71.41 GiB' on every rank) was an environmental stale-residency refusal misread as a code regression; the load plan is already rank-local / EP-aware (internal/ggufload.EstimateExpertParallelLoadMemoryPlan). This gate stops the next such run from being misfiled.

required_free_derivation.formula: internal/compute.RequiredFreeBytes(<per-rank plan total bytes>, headroom) — the exact inverse of BudgetAfterHeadroom, the single home of the load-time fit arithmetic, so the pre-flight threshold can never disagree with the in-process RefuseMemoryPlanIfTooBig gate
required_free_derivation.provenance: per-rank plan totals from experiments/glm-gpu-witness/glm52-ep-load-plan-witness-2026-06-30.json (weights) + the #4952 ~2.08 GiB KV @ --context-budget-tokens 4096

ranks_7.note: exceeds an ~79 GiB-usable 80 GiB-class sm_80 card — RANKS=7 needs a bigger card or >=8 ranks

scenarios.name: A stale-residency (reproduces #4952)
scenarios.verdict: EP_PREFLIGHT_REFUSE (8/8 short ~1.9 GiB) — likely stale residency

scenarios.name: C config-too-tight
scenarios.verdict: EP_PREFLIGHT_REFUSE (7/7 CARD TOO SMALL — need > card total) — raise RANKS / lower context

reproduce: extract the '# --- pre-flight per-GPU free-VRAM gate' block from tools/glm52_ep_witness.sh, stub log()/OUT/DONE/VIS/RANKS and a mock nvidia-smi that echoes 'free, total' MiB per '-i <idx>', and run the five scenarios above (no GPU needed).
fail_open: the gate never blocks a run when nvidia-smi is absent or returns no reading (non-NVIDIA / CI host), and is overridable via REQUIRE_FREE_GIB for any other RANKS/context/model.
